context: Today emit writes negative quantity rows only for SKUs you hold back. One pulled copy shows on the reconcile phantoms list, which only reports it.

options.how: Keep today's path: the phantoms list names it, and you lower it.
options.label: The phantoms list is enough
options.lose: An extra step per pull of a live card.

options.gain: The listing follows the pull with no extra step.
options.how: The pull receipt offers a press that queues a minus-one row for that SKU in the next send.
options.label: One press after the pull
options.lose: More build, and it touches the send path (D54, re-emit adds, never subtracts).

ref: PR 965, draft master-set spec; D100, never delete to lower a price
title: After you pull a card that is live on TCGplayer, should taking the listing down be one press?
why: Ship the checklist first; add the press if the extra step bites.
